name: llm-code-auditor
description: Refactor AI-shaped code into compact, readable, efficient, task-fit code with senior maintainer judgment.

interface.longDescription: Audit and improve generated or agent-written code with a remodel-first agent framework, guide-backed Code Remodel Markup, and targeted skills for abstraction judgment, boundary invariants, readable domain code, generated tests, dependency/API hallucinations, and performance simplicity. The plugin focuses on code that is compact enough, readable, efficient, locally idiomatic, testable, and fit for the actual task while preserving real boundaries instead of blindly deleting abstractions. Static heuristics are supporting evidence and regression checks, not the main cleanup interface.
defaultPrompt: Run a remodel-first code quality pass: model behavior, ownership, and maintainer feedback first in strict CMML, treat static findings as secondary, then make compact behavior-preserving improvements with proof.
Refactor this AI-shaped code into clean, task-fit human-quality code.
Remodel this codebase structure, then fix the real quality problems.
Review these tests for brittle LLM patterns and reward hacking.
